1.why: The screens use a clean sans-serif face with clear label/field hierarchy and comfortable line spacing, though letter spacing is default rather than notably generous.

2.why: No italics or dense paragraphs appear and text is in short lines, but the step indicator 'STEP 1 OF 5' is set in all-caps.

3.why: Content is presented in a single narrow mobile-width column with full-width inputs and button, and remains legible, though the layout is only shown at one viewport.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Confirm your bank account details to protect higher-value payments.' are one short sentence in plain language.

5.why: Placeholder examples 'marcus@example.test' and '+15551234567' plus the hint 'use the displayed example details' show expected input formats.

6.why: Every screen contains only headings, short helper lines and two fields — no long text block must be read to proceed.

7.why: No secret, OTP or recovery-code screen is ever reached in the four screenshots, so no copy affordance for long codes exists in what is observable.

8.why: No QR code or any equivalent alternative to manual entry appears anywhere in the flow, which never advances past sign-in.

9.why: There is no visible indication of autofill/autocomplete support or a password field, and nothing in the screenshots demonstrates password-manager compatibility.

10.why: 'STEP 1 OF 5' with a bold heading and a single solid blue 'Continue securely' button make the step and primary action clear, though the step counter is small and static.

11.why: Each screen asks only for sign-in details with one submit button, so a single main action is requested at a time.

12.why: After pressing Continue the only feedback is 'Unable to sign in with those details.' with an empty Logs panel and no statement of what happened or what comes next.

13.why: The form can be resubmitted, but the flow never exposes any reveal/hide or re-request code capability because it never leaves step 1.

14.why: The error 'Unable to sign in with those details.' is non-blaming but gives no specific problem or remedy, and it persists even when the displayed example details are entered.

15.why: No countdown, timer or expiry warning is shown on any screen, but no code-entry step exists to confirm that generous entry time is actually provided.
